integrity: Exact angular-momentum proof; independent finite-size matrix checks are supplementary, not proof for all sizes. Historical priority not independently settled.
scientific_limitations: Zero-field, spin-1/2, finite friendship graphs with uniform positive hub and rim-pair couplings. The large-size residual entropy is a ground-state degeneracy limit; no finite-temperature transition or robustness is claimed.
title: Extensive critical degeneracy in an antiferromagnetic Heisenberg triangular bouquet
